description:
The supreme leader of the Martial Arts Alliance, Yeop Ji-Chu. He was killed. However, the incident was dismissed as a minor disturbance. However, there were those who remembered it differently… It eventually became the spark of a great disturbance, burning like a wildfire. 

The history of martial arts named this era the era of minor disturbances and great disturbances, and it was the most turbulent time in martial arts, and it was reinterpreted as a higher level of martial arts… It is said to be the era of heroes.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
